name: Restaurant Panoramabahn
kurzbeschreibung:
**Restaurant Panoramabahn in Hollersbach im Pinzgau**

Discover authentic Tyrolean hospitality with breathtaking views of the **Pinzgau** Alps right from your table. At **Restaurant Panoramabahn**, located in the charming village of **Hollersbach im Pinzgau**, you’ll savor hearty regional dishes like **Kaiserschmarrn**, **Schlutzkrapfen**, and fresh trout from the nearby **Salzach** River.

The restaurant is perched near the **Panoramabahn** (scenic railway), offering stunning vistas of snow-capped peaks and lush valleys. Whether you’re enjoying a cozy lunch or a celebratory dinner, the warm atmosphere and delicious flavors make it a perfect stop for travelers exploring **Tirol**.

Don’t miss the chance to try local specialties like **Kaspressknödel** or **Zillertaler Speck**—each bite tells a story of **Tirol**’s rich culinary traditions. After your meal, take a short stroll to explore **Hollersbach im Pinzgau**’s picturesque surroundings or hop on the **Panoramabahn** for an unforgettable alpine adventure.

A must-visit for food lovers and nature enthusiasts alike!
